nodes.label: .fallowrc.json
nodes.description: Configuration file for Fallow, the dead-code/unused-dependency linter. Defines which directories and file patterns to scan, severity thresholds, and output formats.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.description: Agent context file for the voxlblade-builder project. Documents the project overview, tech stack (Svelte 5 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4), project structure, development workflow, and AI agent interaction guidelines.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.description: Project README for the Voxel Blade damage calculator and build optimizer web app.

nodes.label: fallow-output.json
nodes.description: Output report from Fallow dead-code analysis. Contains 28 issues including unused exports, unreachable code, and unused dependencies across the codebase.

nodes.label: fallow-security.json
nodes.description: Security findings report from Fallow. Identifies CWE-79 XSS in DidYouMean.svelte (unsanitized user input in innerHTML) and CWE-502 deserialization risk in decode_full.mjs (eval on base64-encoded JSON).

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.description: Root HTML entry point for the Vite SPA. Contains a single <div id='app'> mount target and a <script type='module' src='/src/main.ts'> tag.

nodes.label: package.json
nodes.description: Project manifest defining the voxlblade package (private, ESM). Scripts: dev (vite), build (vite build), preview, check (svelte-check + tsc). Key dependencies: @vercel/analytics ^2.0.1. Key devDependencies: svelte ^5.55.4, vite ^8.10, typescript ~6.0.2, fallow ^2.104.0, rollup-plugin-visualizer ^7.0.1.

nodes.label: stats-data.json
nodes.description: Generated data file from the Rollup Visualizer bundle analysis plugin. Contains module size statistics used to produce the stats.html report.

nodes.label: stats.html
nodes.description: Generated Rollup Visualizer HTML report showing the bundle composition and size of each module in the built application.

nodes.label: ts-errors.txt
nodes.description: Output file for TypeScript compilation errors. Currently empty, indicating no active type errors.

nodes.label: tsconfig.json
nodes.description: Root TypeScript configuration. Extends tsconfig.app.json as the default project config.

nodes.label: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.description: TypeScript configuration for the application source code. Extends @tsconfig/svelte. Targets ES2023, ESNext modules, enables allowJs/checkJs, includes src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.js, src/**/*.svelte.

nodes.label: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.description: TypeScript configuration for Node-side build tooling (vite.config.ts). Targets ES2023, uses bundler moduleResolution, enables verbatimModuleSyntax and erasableSyntaxOnly.

nodes.label: vercel.json
nodes.description: Vercel deployment configuration. Defines SPA rewrites, build settings, and hosting headers for the deployed application.
